The total is about $23 under your $650 budget. The stats cover 5 Jan 18:00 UTC to 8 Jan 19:00 UTC. The line items had end times of 8 Jan 18:00 UTC (9 Jan 00:00 Dhaka), so no spend should have come after that.

**What the reporting shows**
- X can only report impressions, clicks and spend. Your site has no X pixel, so it can't see trial starts.
- The click-to-trial rate and the cost per trial are unknown. Clicks are not trial starts.
- The "Nine-minute guided" post had the most link clicks (362) and the lowest cost per click, about $0.58. The other two cost about $0.61 and $0.68. That is a click-level difference only. Whether it produced more trials is unknown.

**What I set up**
- One campaign with three ad groups, one per approved post. Each had a $70 daily budget and a $210 total cap.
- Targeting was iOS only, with China excluded, to match the "iPhone only, worldwide except China" offer.
- Targeting was also limited to English speakers. The three approved posts are in English, and you told me not to write new ones. The localized versions you mentioned weren't among the approved posts, so I didn't promote them. Non-English markets were not reached.
- I used the same copy as the approved posts, so the offer stayed accurate, including the 10 Jan 2027 trial deadline.

**What I didn't do**
- I only checked in at intervals of about a day, and the three ad groups performed similarly. I didn't shift budget or pause any ad group during the flight.

**If you run this again:** add the X pixel or another way to attribute trials to the campaign. Without it, the optimization can only target clicks.
